description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentsController class within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It manages the rendering of the dependents information for an employee, including setting up the front-end component and permissions based on the employee number extracted from the request.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentsController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing dependents view and permissions for an employee in the OrangeHRM system. Extends BaseViewEmployeeController and overrides preRender for setting up dependents component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the dependents component for rendering if an employee number is provided in the request. Sets permissions accordingly or handles a bad request if employee number is absent.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for permission checks, specifically 'dependents'.
